proposition: I was in the workshop across the square until just before eleven; a neighbour can confirm it.
quote: He said he’d been in the workshop across the square until just before eleven and that a neighbour could confirm it.

proposition: I do not wish to discuss the disputed sale.
quote: When I asked about the disputed sale he gave a clipped account and shut the subject down.

proposition: he claims he did not kill the victim and was gone before the time of death
quote: "I didn't kill him, if that's what you're getting at. I serviced it—winding, cleaning the pivots—but I was gone by then." (manuscript s-003, L17-L18)
